caption: The video captures a woman in a black one-shoulder flamenco dress with red ruffled lining, seen from behind in a bright studio, while a mirror reflects her front. She stands with hands at her hips, the closed skirt hanging around her legs amid small postural shifts. Her feet begin stepping, lifting and placing with slight blur, and her weight moves through the footwork. One hand reaches down to the skirt edge and pulls the fabric outward, exposing the red underside. She swings the held skirt in a broad arc, the black-and-red ruffles spreading wide as her torso turns. The fabric billows through several steps, stretching into a large flare that follows her motion. She drifts laterally toward the white wall while keeping the skirt extended. The red ruffles fan near the wall as she continues the movement. She remains beside the wall, one hand holding the skirt open, the other near her hip, mirror tracking the pose.
